prompt:
CONCEPT: a female personification of Diaochan (초선), a court official of the rival warlords in the Romance of the Three Kingdoms — the peerless beauty whose chain stratagem turned Dong Zhuo and Lü Bu against each other. Reimagined as a woman; her costume, ornaments, colours and bearing carry her famous deeds and temperament. This is a character design, not a historical portrait.
STYLE: Premium Korean MMORPG promotional character render — an in-engine 3D character model with hand-painted textures, not flat cel shading and not a 2D anime illustration: semi-realistic volumetric forms, porcelain skin with a soft subsurface glow and glossy specular highlights, a small refined face with delicate realistic-anime features, long legs and a narrow waist on a full, curvaceous figure in the body type SILHOUETTE names — soft, rounded volume at the bust, and hips and thighs kept in realistic human proportion: long, shapely legs, never oversized thighs, exaggerated hips or a bottom-heavy figure; never thin, flat or boyishly straight. Polished metal, silk and gems catch sharp highlights. Extremely intricate ornamented costume — filigree metalwork, jewel inlays, layered translucent fabrics and fine embroidery. Luxurious, high-detail finish.
TRAITS of Diaochan to carry in her design and the scene: a beauty before whom the moon hid behind the clouds, a dancer of the palace, the linked-rings stratagem, silk ribbons and moonlight, quiet courage behind grace.
FACTION — the rival warlords. Palette: soft pastel pink, blush rose, ivory white and pale rose gold, with small lilac accents.
AGE: about twenty — a fresh young-adult face; no facial lines.
SILHOUETTE: slender-limbed yet full-busted with rounded hips and a narrow waist build; long straight hair with curtain bangs; royal-purple hair.
FACE — she must read as her own person at a glance, NOT the style's default pretty face and not a sister of the other characters: first impression — an elegant, refined presence; porcelain-pale skin; heart-shaped face; large eyes — wide almond eyes, outer eye corners drooping downward; thin arched brows; small button nose; full heart-shaped lips; pale violet eyes; a small beauty mark under one eye. Whatever the face shape, keep soft, feminine, attractive contours with a small, soft chin — never elongated, horse-like, mannish or heavy-jawed. Face proportions: a short, compact midface — the eyes sit at about the vertical middle of the head and the eyes-to-mouth distance is short; the face is only slightly longer than it is wide (about 1.3 : 1 from hairline to chin), with a small, softly rounded chin. Long bangs, side locks or a tall headpiece frame the face but never make it look longer.
WORLD — MEDIEVAL FANTASY: the shattered realms of medieval high fantasy, an age of rival warlords after a fallen empire: a ruined imperial capital, mercenary camps, border keeps, outlaw marches and wild southern jungles, dark violet battle-magic. COSTUME (medieval fantasy): a royal chancellor's or court scholar's dress — a long embroidered coat with a stole, a seal ring, ledgers and a quill. Western medieval high-fantasy dress — plate, mail and heraldic tabards, gowns and mantles, circlets and crowns; steel, leather, wool, velvet and gold, subtle magical glow along the patterns. Her Three Kingdoms origin shows only through her signature item, her colours and her bearing — her outfit is Western: no wrap-collar robes, no wide hanfu sleeves, no flowing Chinese-style robe over armor, no East-Asian armor, no machinery, no modern material. The setting is Western European medieval — stone castles, Romanesque or Gothic architecture, European mountains, forests and towns; no Chinese architecture, no pagodas or curved tiled roofs, no hanzi on banners. LIGHT: natural daylight or the world's own magical glow, unless TIME & WEATHER says otherwise. Celestial ornament: feather-and-gold wing-shaped ornaments at the shoulders or back, a translucent gauze overskirt, a jewelled circlet.
OUTFIT SILHOUETTE: a floor-length priestly vestment with gold-trimmed stoles and a tall head ornament — a long, devout silhouette. Only the overall shape is fixed; design the details freely. This silhouette overrides the overall shape of the role costume above.
MOOD: serene celestial key art — pastel sky light, a soft halo of light behind her, floating golden light particles and drifting feathers.
EXPOSURE (bold): her regalia opens to show skin — bare shoulders and arms between pauldron and bracer, a deep open neckline under the gorget with natural cleavage, a high slit in the tabard or gown showing the thigh; armor pieces stay on and symmetrical. Nothing slipped off. Chest and pelvis covered; no corset; keep the costume WORLD describes, material and palette.
OUTPUT: one character image that works as card art. Vertical 2:3 frame, full body with head and feet inside the frame with clear margins, face turned toward the camera (front or three-quarter). Standing, card-ready pose; the environment may be rich while her design stays fully readable.
SIGNATURE ITEM: a folding silk dance fan — reimagined as a Western high-fantasy version of the same kind of object with the same silhouette: polished steel and silvered mithril throughout, the shaft or hilt also forged metal with engraved runes (never plain wood), a faint magical glow running along the edge and the runes, a gem-set guard or socket, a leather-wrapped grip and heraldic or elven ornament, with any animal motif re-sculpted in Western heraldic style and no Chinese fittings, silk tassels or hanzi. She holds or carries it, drawn at full scale. It is one whole object drawn once: a long weapon (spear, glaive, halberd, staff, bow) keeps a single straight, unbroken shaft from butt to head with exactly one head or blade, held in front of or beside her body — never passing behind her head or shoulders, never broken, bent, split in two by her body or arm, or duplicated; if the frame cuts it, it leaves the frame as one straight line.
EXPRESSION: softly lidded eyes, lips relaxed. Keep it subtle and natural, a light touch rather than acting: no sneer, glare, smirk-pulled cheek or chin lifted to look down at the viewer; her face stays relaxed and attractive.
BODY: a normal human body — one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint. Hands and feet may be partly hidden by the pose or the frame.
ONE FIGURE ONLY. No second character, no horse or other creature, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border. No readable text or numbers — banners and shields carry only heraldic devices (a beast or a crest), never letters or Chinese characters.
ANATOMY: natural adult proportions, both hands drawn correctly as hands. No extra limbs.

SKIN COLOUR AND RENDERING:
Her own skin tone — porcelain-pale skin — rendered luminous and lifelike: bright, softly glowing diffuse midtones on the face, neck, shoulders, arms, hands and exposed legs, not only in the specular highlights; one consistent underlying complexion across the whole body, varying only with light and shadow. Shadows stay clean and warm within her own skin tone — never grey-violet, muddy brown, blue-grey or heavily desaturated. Delicate satin-like highlights, subtle texture, lifelike translucency and softly dimensional shading. Do not whiten or darken her skin tone, do not clip highlights or remove all shadows; no chalky, ashen, waxy or uniformly glossy skin, and the costume or setting never tints her skin.

LIGHTING AND COLOUR:
A bright, elegant high-key cinematic grade with luminous skin and clean colour separation. Soft bright frontal fill light gently lifts the face and exposed skin, keeping the midtones bright, translucent and evenly readable, with gentle, open, colour-clean shadows around the eyes, nose, lips, neck and limbs. The scene's own light comes from behind and to one side as a restrained rim, tracing hair strands, shoulder edges and fabric. Reflections from the costume, stone, metal or sky never cast a strong blue, purple, grey or orange tint on her skin. No heavy colour grade, dark crushed contrast, muddy shadows or cool desaturation.

CAMERA AND COMPOSITION:
Vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots; the figure occupies most of the image height, and her head, hair ornaments, both hands, her signature item and both boots stay inside the frame. Natural portrait perspective — no wide-angle distortion and no exaggerated low camera angle; facial and body proportions stay balanced. She is sharply resolved from face to boots, the distance falls into gentle optical blur with clear atmospheric depth, and her face keeps enough detail to read her eyes, features and expression. No text, logo or watermark.
